topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Error text: Present – Past
title: Find the Tense Errors: Present and Past

explanation.tr:
Bu alıştırmada present ve past zamanlarındaki hataları bulacaksın. Kontrol listesi:
• Zaman ifadesi geçmişi mi gösteriyor (yesterday, last, ago)? → Simple Past
• Alışkanlık mı (every day, usually)? → Simple Present
• Simple Present 3. tekil: -s (she works)
• Simple Past olumsuz/soru: did + yalın fiil (didn't go, Did you see?)
• Düzensiz fiiller: went, saw, bought, came…
• was/were uyumu: I/he was, you/we/they were
explanation.tk:
Bu gönükmede present we past zamanlaryndaky ýalňyşlary taparsyň. Barlag sanawy:
• Wagt aňlatmasy geçmişi görkezýärmi (yesterday, last, ago)? → Simple Past
• Endikmi (every day, usually)? → Simple Present
• Simple Present 3-nji ýöňkeme birlik: -s (she works)
• Simple Past ýokluk/sorag: did + esasy işlik (didn't go, Did you see?)
• Nädogry işlikler: went, saw, bought, came…
• was/were laýyklygy: I/he was, you/we/they were
explanation.ru:
В этом упражнении нужно найти ошибки в present и past. Чек-лист:
• Указывает ли выражение времени на прошлое (yesterday, last, ago)? → Simple Past
• Привычка (every day, usually)? → Simple Present
• Simple Present, 3-е лицо ед. ч.: -s (she works)
• Simple Past, отрицание/вопрос: did + начальная форма (didn't go, Did you see?)
• Неправильные глаголы: went, saw, bought, came…
• was/were: I/he was, you/we/they were

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Future Tenses in English
title: Future Forms: will, going to, Present Progressive, Simple Present

explanation.tr:
İngilizcede geleceği anlatmanın birkaç yolu vardır:
• will: anlık kararlar, tahminler, sözler → I'll help you. I think it will rain.
• going to: önceden plan/niyet, görünen işarete dayalı tahmin → I'm going to study medicine. Look, it's going to rain!
• Present Progressive: kesinleşmiş randevu/düzenleme → I'm meeting Sara at 6 tomorrow.
• Simple Present: tarifeler, programlar → The train leaves at 7:15. The film starts at 8.
• Future Progressive: gelecekte belli anda devam eden eylem → At 9 I'll be working.
explanation.tk:
Iňlis dilinde geljegi aňlatmagyň birnäçe ýoly bar:
• will: şol pursatdaky kararlar, çaklamalar, wadalar → I'll help you. I think it will rain.
• going to: öňünden meýilnama/niýet, görünýän alamata esaslanan çaklama → I'm going to study medicine. Look, it's going to rain!
• Present Progressive: anyklanan duşuşyk/gurnama → I'm meeting Sara at 6 tomorrow.
• Simple Present: tertipnamalar, maksatnamalar → The train leaves at 7:15. The film starts at 8.
• Future Progressive: geljekde belli pursatda dowam edýän hereket → At 9 I'll be working.
explanation.ru:
В английском есть несколько способов говорить о будущем:
• will: спонтанные решения, прогнозы, обещания → I'll help you. I think it will rain.
• going to: заранее принятые планы/намерения, прогноз по признакам → I'm going to study medicine. Look, it's going to rain!
• Present Progressive: договорённости → I'm meeting Sara at 6 tomorrow.
• Simple Present: расписания, программы → The train leaves at 7:15. The film starts at 8.
• Future Progressive: действие в процессе в момент будущего → At 9 I'll be working.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Future Tenses in English – Rules
title: Future Tenses: Rules at a Glance

explanation.tr:
Gelecek zaman seçme kuralları (kısa liste):
1. Konuşurken karar verdin mi? → will (I'll take this one.)
2. Önceden planladın mı? → going to (I'm going to visit Rome.)
3. Tarih, saat ve kişiyle ayarlanmış mı? → Present Progressive (I'm flying to Baku on Monday.)
4. Tarife/program mı? → Simple Present (The shop opens at 9.)
5. Fikir/tahmin mi? → will (I think / probably / maybe)
6. Gözle görülen işaret mi? → going to (He's going to fall!)
Unutma: when, if, before, after, as soon as'ten sonra will kullanılmaz: When I get home, I'll call you.
explanation.tk:
Geljek zamany saýlamagyň düzgünleri (gysga sanaw):
1. Gürläp durkaň karar berdiňmi? → will (I'll take this one.)
2. Öňünden meýilleşdirdiňmi? → going to (I'm going to visit Rome.)
3. Sene, wagt we adam bilen gurnaldymy? → Present Progressive (I'm flying to Baku on Monday.)
4. Tertipnama/maksatnama? → Simple Present (The shop opens at 9.)
5. Pikir/çaklama? → will (I think / probably / maybe)
6. Göze görünýän alamat? → going to (He's going to fall!)
Ýatda sakla: when, if, before, after, as soon as-dan soň will ulanylmaýar: When I get home, I'll call you.
explanation.ru:
Правила выбора будущего времени (кратко):
1. Решил в момент речи? → will (I'll take this one.)
2. Спланировал заранее? → going to (I'm going to visit Rome.)
3. Договорённость с датой, временем, людьми? → Present Progressive (I'm flying to Baku on Monday.)
4. Расписание/программа? → Simple Present (The shop opens at 9.)
5. Мнение/прогноз? → will (I think / probably / maybe)
6. Видимый признак? → going to (He's going to fall!)
Помни: после when, if, before, after, as soon as не ставится will: When I get home, I'll call you.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Past Perfect and Simple Past (Statements)
title: Past Perfect or Simple Past?

explanation.tr:
İki geçmiş olay anlatırken:
• Sırayla anlatıyorsan iki fiil de Simple Past olabilir: I got up, had a shower and left.
• Bir olayın DAHA ÖNCE olduğunu vurgulamak için Past Perfect: When I arrived, the film had started. (Film benden önce başlamıştı.)
• Karşılaştır:
  When I arrived, the film started. (Ben gelince başladı.)
  When I arrived, the film had started. (Ben gelmeden başlamıştı.)
• after/before zaten sırayı gösterdiği için Simple Past da olur: After I finished, I went out.
explanation.tk:
Iki geçmiş wakany gürrüň berlende:
• Yzygiderli gürrüň berseň, iki işlik hem Simple Past bolup biler: I got up, had a shower and left.
• Bir wakanyň HAS ÖŇ bolandygyny nygtamak üçin Past Perfect: When I arrived, the film had started. (Film menden öň başlapdy.)
• Deňeşdir:
  When I arrived, the film started. (Men gelenimde başlady.)
  When I arrived, the film had started. (Men gelmänkäm başlapdy.)
• after/before tertibi eýýäm görkezýändigi üçin Simple Past hem bolýar: After I finished, I went out.
explanation.ru:
Когда рассказываешь о двух событиях в прошлом:
• Если по порядку — оба глагола могут быть в Simple Past: I got up, had a shower and left.
• Чтобы подчеркнуть, что одно событие было РАНЬШЕ, — Past Perfect: When I arrived, the film had started. (Фильм начался до моего прихода.)
• Сравни:
  When I arrived, the film started. (Начался, когда я пришёл.)
  When I arrived, the film had started. (Начался до того, как я пришёл.)
• С after/before порядок уже ясен, поэтому можно Simple Past: After I finished, I went out.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Present Perfect or Present Perfect Progressive
title: Present Perfect or Present Perfect Progressive?

explanation.tr:
İki zaman da geçmişi şimdiye bağlar ama vurgu farklıdır:
• Present Perfect → SONUÇ, miktar, kaç kez: I have written three emails. I have read the book. (bitti)
• Present Perfect Progressive → SÜRE, devam eden süreç: I have been writing emails all morning. I have been reading the book. (hâlâ okuyorum)
• 'how many / how much' → Present Perfect; 'how long' → çoğu zaman Progressive.
• Durum fiilleri (know, like, have=sahip olmak) progressive olmaz: I have known him for years.
explanation.tk:
Iki zaman hem geçmişi häzir bilen baglaýar, emma nygtaýşy dürli:
• Present Perfect → NETIJE, mukdar, näçe gezek: I have written three emails. I have read the book. (tamamlandy)
• Present Perfect Progressive → DOWAMLYLYK, dowam edýän proses: I have been writing emails all morning. I have been reading the book. (henizem okaýaryn)
• 'how many / how much' → Present Perfect; 'how long' → köplenç Progressive.
• Ýagdaý işlikleri (know, like, have=eýe bolmak) progressive bolmaýar: I have known him for years.
explanation.ru:
Оба времени связывают прошлое с настоящим, но акцент разный:
• Present Perfect → РЕЗУЛЬТАТ, количество, сколько раз: I have written three emails. I have read the book. (закончил)
• Present Perfect Progressive → ДЛИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ, процесс: I have been writing emails all morning. I have been reading the book. (всё ещё читаю)
• 'how many / how much' → Present Perfect; 'how long' → чаще Progressive.
• Глаголы состояния (know, like, have=иметь) не бывают в progressive: I have known him for years.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Past or Past Progressive
title: Simple Past or Past Progressive?

explanation.tr:
• Simple Past: geçmişte bitmiş, kısa/tamamlanmış eylemler; sırayla olan olaylar.
  I called her. Then I went to bed.
• Past Progressive: geçmişte belli bir anda devam eden, uzun eylemler; arka plan.
  At 9 pm I was watching TV.
• Birlikte: uzun eylem (Past Progressive) + onu kesen kısa eylem (Simple Past)
  I was watching TV when the phone rang.
• while + uzun eylem: While I was cooking, the lights went out.
• Aynı anda iki uzun eylem: While I was reading, my brother was sleeping.
explanation.tk:
• Simple Past: geçmişde gutaran, gysga/tamamlanan hereketler; yzygiderli wakalar.
  I called her. Then I went to bed.
• Past Progressive: geçmişde belli bir pursatda dowam eden, uzak hereketler; fon.
  At 9 pm I was watching TV.
• Bilelikde: uzak hereket (Past Progressive) + ony kesýän gysga hereket (Simple Past)
  I was watching TV when the phone rang.
• while + uzak hereket: While I was cooking, the lights went out.
• Bir wagtda iki uzak hereket: While I was reading, my brother was sleeping.
explanation.ru:
• Simple Past: законченные, короткие действия в прошлом; последовательность событий.
  I called her. Then I went to bed.
• Past Progressive: длительное действие в определённый момент прошлого; фон.
  At 9 pm I was watching TV.
• Вместе: длительное (Past Progressive) + прерывающее короткое (Simple Past)
  I was watching TV when the phone rang.
• while + длительное действие: While I was cooking, the lights went out.
• Два длительных одновременно: While I was reading, my brother was sleeping.
